appearance.extreme: Their jaw is distended around the glands and their hands are permanently wet with venom. Where they rested a palm, the table has gone soft.
appearance.obvious: Glands bulge under their jaw, and their knuckles weep a clear fluid that beads and doesn't dry.
appearance.subtle: There's a swelling under their jaw on both sides.

description: Glands under your jaw and along your knuckles, full of something that isn't supposed to be in a person. Anything you break the skin of gets a dose.
drawbacks: You have to be careful about kissing anyone
name: Venom Glands
